description: Miroozan wears a dark navy long wool coat with restrained brown-gray fur trim at the collar, cuffs, front edges and lower hem. Fine pale gold geometric woven borders and small motifs decorate the coat fronts, sleeves and hem. The cream linen shirt underneath has dark blue embroidery around its split neckline and lower edge. Several paired circular metal clasps appear along the upper coat opening. A broad navy-and-gold woven sash circles the waist and hangs down with a fringed end. Brown trousers and tall dark brown leather boots finish the ensemble. Both hands hang naturally at his sides. His head is uncovered, without armor, weapon or crown.
